pilot_selection: One minimum metadata-filename SHA256 rank per nonempty exact frozen alias/source-filing-era cell over the complete validated historical index census; controls selected before candidate filtering
final_qa_rank_unchanged: SHA256 UTF8(study_id|phase2-qa-v1|family|era|form|source_kind|accession|source_document_sha256); tie by stable source ID
qualifying_certification: No automatic certification from keywords, schema guesses, acceptance timestamps or filing dates
timing_policy: Raw acceptance retained; normalization requires separately verified source-zone semantics; dissemination requires independent evidence; missing/conflicting evidence stays TIMESTAMP_UNRESOLVED
review_policy: Actual reviewer IDs, source/input hashes, reason, evidence IDs, timestamps and append-only supersession; independent second review for disagreement; no simulated human review
schema_policy: Version/root/namespace detected; structural parsing is not XSD validation. Unknown versions retained unresolved. Official historical schema authority and supported-feature validation required before final gate.

acceptance_criteria_before_final_qa.precision_denominator: Resolved positive factual-subtype proposals with independent gold labels; mandatory private/plan/unresolved candidates are not screened out to raise precision
